note: The scales, bands and advice of docs/SPEC.md section 6, in 1 place. The engine bands numbers with it; the web page draws scales and shows advice from it; the connector will quote it. Numbers are rounded to whole numbers before banding. The last band of each scale is open; marker_max is where its marker stops on the drawn scale.

api.name: API
api.source: DOE's Air Pollutant Index; band names checked in the APIMS portal, 15 Oct 2026
api.doe_advice_source: DOE, "General Information of Air Pollutant Index", table "Air Pollutant Index: Health Effect", column "Health Advice"

doe_advice.Good: No restriction for outdoor activities to the public. Maintain healthy lifestyle.
doe_advice.Moderate: No restriction for outdoor activities to the public. Maintain healthy lifestyle.
doe_advice.Unhealthy: Limited outdoor activities for the high risk people. Public need to reduce the extreme outdoor activities.
doe_advice.Very unhealthy: Old and high risk people are advised to stay indoor and reduce physical activities. People with health complications are advised to see doctor.
doe_advice.Hazardous: Old and high risk people are prohibited for outdoor activities. Public are advised to prevent from outdoor activities.

us_aqi.name: US AQI
us_aqi.source: US EPA's Air Quality Index, as aqicn, IQAir and Google use it

conversions.note: From a 24-hour PM2.5 average in µg/m³ to each index, and back (SPEC section 18), read by engine/convert.py (the engine and the connector) and web/src/convert.ts (the page). Each segment: from and to in µg/m³, then either the index at each end (straight lines between breakpoints) or DOE's own form, index = slope times (x minus minus) plus plus. The concentration is first rounded as each agency does; the index is rounded to a whole point, halves up. Above the last segment its line goes on. They hold when fine smoke drives the index, as in a haze.

psi.name: PSI
psi.source: NEA's PSI sub-index for 24-hour PM2.5 (haze.gov.sg). Checked: 136 µg/m³ gives 185, as NEA published at 4:00 am on 15 Oct 2026; and every logged hour with PSI over 100 since 15 Aug 2026 (1,763) within 1 point of NEA's own.
